She is an accomplished Rhyhorn racer from [[Vaniville Town]]. In {{aniseries|PTS}}, Grace is the mother of {{an|Serena}} and appears as a recurring character during ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''. In the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, she is the mother of {{adv|Y}}. ==In the core series games== [[File:Grace Home XY.png|thumb|left|200px|Grace talking to her daughter]] Grace is the mother of the [[player character]] in [[Pokémon X and Y]]. She is mentioned by other Trainers as being a former {{p|Rhyhorn}} racer, being quite popular in the sport. She moves to [[Vaniville Town]] in [[Kalos]] around the start of the game, where her child begins their {{pkmn|journey}} as a [[Pokémon Trainer]]. She gives the player the [[Town Map]] after the player receives the [[Pokédex]]. {{color2|fff|Pokémon X and Y|X and Y}} |} ==In animation== ==={{aniseries|XY}}=== [[File:Grace and Serena.png|thumb|250px|Grace and Serena]] Grace debuted in ''[[XY001|Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!]]'', where she had her {{p|Fletchling}} wake up {{an|Serena}} for her since she herself was not successful in doing so. After Serena woke up, Grace told her to get ready for {{p|Rhyhorn}} riding practice. In ''[[XY002|Lumiose City Pursuit]]'', Grace had Serena ride on her Rhyhorn in order to become an accomplished Rhyhorn racer. However, as Serena had trouble controlling it, she fell off it. Later, Grace told Serena to watch the news as it featured a {{p|Garchomp}} going on a rampage in [[Lumiose City]]. In ''[[XY003|A Battle of Aerial Mobility!]]'', Grace wished Serena good luck on her {{pkmn|journey}} as her daughter set off to Lumiose City to get her [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. She appeared again in ''[[XY007|Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race!]]'', where Serena introduced her to {{TP|Serena|Fennekin}}, {{Ash}}, {{an|Clemont}}, {{an|Bonnie}}, {{AP|Pikachu}}, and {{TP|Clemont|Dedenne}}. Grace told Serena to continue traveling with Ash and the others, saying that it would be good for her. She reappeared in ''[[XY053|A Race for Home!]]'' and ''[[XY059|Under the Pledging Tree!]]'', and in Serena's flashback in ''[[XY060|A Showcase Debut!]]''. In ''[[XY080|Performing with Fiery Charm!]]'', Grace watched Serena competing in the [[Dendemille Town]] [[Pokémon Showcase]] on television, alongside her Rhyhorn and Fletchling. In ''[[XY112|Master Class is in Session!]]'' and ''[[XY113|Performing a Pathway to the Future!]]'', Grace personally watched Serena performing in the Pokémon Showcase Master Class in [[Gloire City]] as an audience member. She reappeared in ''[[XY138|The First Day of the Rest of Your Life!]]'', and then in ''[[XY140|Till We Compete Again!]]'' during a flashback. ====Pokémon==== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} =====At home===== This listing is of Grace's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Grace |pkmn=Fletchling |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Grace Fletchling.png |vaen=Lisa Ortiz |epnum=XY001 |epname=Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin! |desc={{p|Fletchling}} is the family pet owned by Grace. She is a famous Rhyhorn Racer. ====Prior to {{MangaArc|X & Y}}==== Grace achieved a streak of 25 consecutive wins as a Rhyhorn Racer. She wanted Y to also become a Rhyhorn Racer and had trained her daughter since she was a small child. Annoyed that her mother attempted to decide her destiny for her, Y decided to go against her mother's wishes and become a {{tc|Sky Trainer}}, the opposite of a ground-based Rhyhorn Racer, instead. As such, the two are not on good terms. With {{adv|X}}'s parents off in a faraway region due to their work, Grace took the liberty of keeping him fed due to X refusing to leave his room. ===={{MangaArc|X & Y}}==== Grace is first seen in person at [[Cyllage City]] where she is spotted by [[Grant]] and [[Clemont]]. She is approached by a {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}} and attempts to escape, but several more appear until she is surrounded. Defeated, Grace is taken away by the Grunts to Team Flare's base, where other people from Vaniville Town are also being kept. [[Chalmers]], a {{tc|Team Flare Admin}}, expresses annoyance at how Grace managed to escape from them over five times. Seeing how a strong person like Grace get captured again makes the townspeople worried about their situation, but Grace tells them to not give up hope. Later, Grace utilizes the help of a wild {{p|Klefki}} she had befriended to steal the keys of a sleeping Team Flare Grunt and open the cells of the captured Vaniville Town residents. Grace leads the people out to freedom, but before they can escape, [[Celosia]] arrives and uses her {{p|Aegislash}} to control them. Grace and the captured townspeople are taken to a forest where Xerneas sleeps. They are tasked with loading Xerneas's tree form into a vehicle so that it can be moved to Team Flare's base. As Celosia watches over the operation, her {{p|Honedge}} presents a piece of hair that it slashed off of Y's head during an earlier confrontation. Grace notices the clump of hair, which causes the mind control to slightly falter when she recognizes that it belongs to her daughter. Grace's behavior annoys Celosia, who promptly pushes Grace onto the ground. When Y notices what is going on, she immediately leaps from her hiding spot to rescue her mother but is quickly defeated by Celosia. After Grace and the other Vaniville Town residents are freed, they are taken to a Laverre City hospital to recuperate. Grace makes one final appearance at the end of this chapter, reuniting tearfully with Y. ====Pokémon==== =====Given away===== {{anchor|Rhyhorn 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Grace |pkmn=Rhyhorn |type1=Ground |type2=Rock |gender=male |img=Grace Rhyhorn Adventures.png |epnum=PS549 |epname=An X-cuse to Come Out and Play |desc=This {{p|Rhyhorn}} is Grace's only known Pokémon. None of Rhyhorn's moves are known and his Ability is {{a|Rock Head}}.}} =====Befriended===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Grace |pkmn=Klefki |type1=Steel |type2=Fairy |img=Klefki Adventures.png |epnum=PS573 |epname=Gathering Klefki |desc=Grace befriended this wild {{p|Klefki}}, which helped her break free from her cells numerous times.
